text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I'm about to eat lunch in my
office,
when...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Why do you have to be here?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
If I can't stay here, the only other place
is behind
the gym...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...You can let me be by myself.
choice_data_list: 何かできることはない？
choice_data_list_en: Isn't there anything I can do?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Classrooms, the plaza, the roof... There's
people
everywhere. I can't get any
peace.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grasping the situation, I decide to move
myself
to a cafe, when...
